note: Cottage resort on a quiet Table Rock Lake cove near Cape Fair with four RV sites near the entrance; RV guests share the pool, swimming and fishing docks, playground and trails. --Claude
summary: Operator 2026 rates page: RV $40/night (site card still shows $49/$29), 4 full-hookup 30/50A sites (3 pull-through, 1 back-in), online (Little Hotelier) or phone booking, 3-night holiday minimum. Not waterfront kept: the RV area by the entrance is ~120 m+ uphill from the cove behind the cottages.
flags: Rates disagree on the operator's own site: rates.html (2026 season) and rv-parking.html say $40 a night; the bookable RV-site card says 'Peak Season $49/nt Off Season $29/nt'. Either way under $50. Google Maps 'The Cottages at Fair Haven Cove' 4.9 over 86 (reviews mostly of cottages); RV Life 4* over 4.
Waterfront: not waterfront kept - the gravel RV area near the highway entrance is about 120 m or more from the cove, with cottages and trees between.
